settings.memoryMeasurement: Per-child wait4 peak resident set in bytes on Unix; null on platforms without wait4.

protocol.description: Initial frozen baseline with repository-level split isolation. Source/patch annotations are agent-reviewed, sparse, and not independently validated ground truth. No ranking adjustments are made using these runs.

interpretation: Agent-reviewed patch-derived labels are sparse, not independently validated ground truth. Unclassified files are not noise. Failed cases contribute zero to recall and completeness. Supporting-range and judged-precision means show only available annotations; inspect annotation counts and errors. Public evaluation cases cease to be held out when used to tune ranking.
measurementNotes: Seven completed language partitions were retained. A superseded serial Java partition was interrupted and discarded in full; Java was rerun with five case workers using the same immutable evaluator, sources, labels and 180-second deadline.
Batches and supplementary probes overlapped on a contended local host. These are single diagnostic wall-time samples, not uncontended latency measurements or speedup evidence.
Production retrieval source/resource fingerprints match the start of the task. No retrieval ranking was tuned on this corpus.
The binary hash identifies the measured release build. A later legacy-report comparison guard affects --baseline comparisons only, which these measurements do not invoke.

This reference predates the explicit Git-discovery ceiling. No Git location overrides were inherited and scratch paths have no tracked ancestor history, so no ancestor-history ranking signals were available.

validation.makeCheck: passed: 61 Rust tests, 56 Python tests, formatting and clippy
validation.finalBinarySmoke: Pinned Chi case: both methods reproduce measured source hash, selected files, excerpts, quality and token metrics exactly; timings excluded.
